description: Export memories as JSON for backup or migration. Supports filtering by scope, namespace, and department. Max 1000 records per export.

department.description: Department (e.g., legal, engineering, hr, sales, finance)

limit.description: Maximum memories to export in this page (live, top-level only)

namespace.description: Namespace within scope (e.g., project name, team name)

offset.description: Pagination offset; use with has_more to export a large corpus in pages

name: memory_export
